contract_conflict: review-ledger.schema.json defines one closed review-ledger/v1 object, while validate_freeze.py consumes a package ledger as an array or object.review_ledgers and needs one exact oracle_id per record. A single root object cannot both pass that closed schema and map all three AAPL oracle IDs. This package wrapper uses three individually schema-shaped review-ledger/v1 records and the validator-supported review_ledgers form. This is an accepted structural wrapper condition, not a current release blocker.
